title: Star Life Cycle: Why Mass Decides Its Fate | Space Atlas
description: Every star is born the same way. What it becomes at the end — white dwarf, neutron star, or black hole — depends entirely on how much mass it started with.
ogTitle: Star Life Cycle: Why Mass Decides a Star's Fate
ogDescription: Two stars, same birth, completely different deaths — toggle between a Sun-like star and a massive star's life cycle.
jsonldDescription: A branching walkthrough of stellar evolution, comparing a Sun-like star's life cycle to a massive star's life cycle and explaining why initial mass determines the outcome.
